answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the saffron forfeiture shows up in the quill totals with the knoll audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 35% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 141 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
